title: Browser design dos and don'ts, from static web apps to full 3D sites
why: shiv, Nov 1 12:21 CST, in chat to triage (page item 125): "we need browser design guidelines dos and donts etc send an opus lane surf the web look through suggested mcps get me everything and remember my own preferences avoiding hard coding, outcomes based, etc. plus the university that is claude-settings that goes into full fledged 3d sites and static web apps". Owner named Opus for this lane (agent-model-cap grant for this spawn).
note: Scope: design guidance for anything that runs in a browser, from a static web app to a full 3D site (WebGL, three.js and the like). 1) Read what we have first and add only what is missing: docs/design/principles.md (record ux-house-rules, whose rules state only what Vercel web-interface-guidelines, impeccable and frontend-design do not), checklist.md, a11y.md, layout.md, tokens.md, skills impeccable, frontend-design, design-explore and design-review. 2) Research the web: platform and standards guidance (WCAG, web.dev Core Web Vitals, MDN), well-regarded design-system guidance, and 3D-specific practice (performance budgets, motion and reduced-motion, input and fallback when WebGL is off). 3) Look through suggested MCP servers and skills for design work and say which would help, with a vet note for each (decision on outside code: a read-only vet before any install). 4) Keep the owner's standing preferences: outcomes first (judge each rule by the person the page serves), no hard-coded values where a token or the platform gives one, one home per capability, plain words. Output: a draft of new house rules in principles.md form (id, rule, Check, Source), each with its source link, plus a short list of MCPs or skills to vet; rules the owner must pick between go to triage as page questions. A rule's text changes, so record-writer and reviewer land it. Done check: the new rules and checklist lines are on main, each with a source, and ste-lint passes; the MCP list is in the lane's report. Needs no answer.
